blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, kayaks, and paddle boards to explore the backwaters, mangrove rivers, and islands near Marco Island and Naples. The marina offers boat docks for rent and guided kayak tours through local waterways. Staff provide safety equipment and orientation for boat rentals, and can offer tips on local fishing and wildlife spotting.
extraNote: Rates do not include fuel for pontoon boats · Kayaking is weather dependent; no tours during storms · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · We're looking forward to your reservation! Please arrive 30 minutes ahead for an easy check-in. · Marina office around back of building at 292 Capri Blvd, Isles of Capri · May - October and November - April
